features.text: Child-friendly design with telescoping bars that adjust easily to fit growing legs and different leg lengths
Gentle yet secure support system helps protect healing ligaments and meniscus tissue
Customizable fit ensures comfort and proper alignment during recovery
Professional-grade materials provide durability while staying lightweight for young patients
Easy-to-use adjustment system helps parents maintain proper therapeutic positioning

indications: ACL, PCL, MCL and LCL Injuries
measurement: Finding the right fit is crucial for your child's comfort and recovery. For optimal support and comfort, visit our Perfect Fit Promise page where our pediatric brace experts will help ensure the perfect fit for your child.
